options.denominator: Not applicable; absolute annual count of pedestrian deaths
options.reason: Annual counts directly answer how many pedestrians were killed in each calendar year without adding an unnecessary denominator.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the question directly by summing pedestrian fatalities for crashes in each year, and the chart shows the year-to-year counts from 2013 through 2025. It leaves no part of the stated question unanswered, though it does not break deaths down by crash location or other characteristics.
